summary: Juvenility claim overruled; brick bat injuries inconsistency addressed; common intention vs common object distinction acknowledged; ocular testimony reliability upheld; injured witnesses' evidentiary weight emphasized; medical record absence of finger injury explained as minor; genesis of offence established; conviction under IPC 302/307/148 with 34 sustained; sentence of life imprisonment confirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.34, s.148, s.302, s.307
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; Trial Court conviction and life sentence upheld as affirmed by High Court.
